title: Local model browser and real 7B verification
description: Local model browser and real 7B verification for the approved ARA-022 plan.
acceptance_criteria: Given isolated real core services and deterministic Ollama HTTP fixtures, when browser workflows run, then background completion, pause/reload/resume, default deletion and grounded local responses persist.
Given an explicitly authorized fresh live validation volume, when the opt-in runner executes, then only exact7B weights are pulled and measured engine results are separated from fixture results.
Given process/service interruption, when recovery runs, then persistent jobs settle and resume without editing authoritative state or resetting development data.
test_cases: Playwright E2E09 background/navigation/browser closure; E2E10 pause/reload/resume; E2E11 default deletion; E2E12 local grounded summary/Q&A fixture.
Isolated backend real PostgreSQL/Redis/MinIO suites; runtime real-route/race/server tests.
Opt-in real7B hashes, template, streaming, schema, thinking, memory/latency and independent operation pause/inference.
verification: Fresh full Playwright 12 passed in 2.0 minutes; final deletion/default and local summary/chat (2 tests) passed in 43.8 seconds after refreshed workers. Lead backend 185/frontend 356 passed; infrastructure 4 and HTTP fixture 3 passed. Generated OpenAPI contract byte-matched. Real 7B exact hashes/range resume/stream/schema/thinking, app summary/Q&A/provenance and six-service restart persistence passed with no OpenAI key. Full app peak 11.85 GiB, steady 6.65 GiB, OOM zero. No 3.7B/27B/GPU/amd64 inference claim.
